# AdaptiveProbeConfig { #dyf.AdaptiveProbeConfig }

```python
AdaptiveProbeConfig(margin_lo=0.01, margin_hi=0.1, min_probes=1, max_probes=5)
```

Configuration for adaptive probe count based on routing margin.

Queries with small routing margins (near decision boundaries) probe more
leaves; confident queries (large margins) probe fewer. Linear interpolation
between min_probes and max_probes based on where min_margin falls between
margin_lo and margin_hi.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [margin_hi](#dyf.AdaptiveProbeConfig.margin_hi) | Convert a string or number to a floating point number, if possible. |
| [margin_lo](#dyf.AdaptiveProbeConfig.margin_lo) | Convert a string or number to a floating point number, if possible. |
| [max_probes](#dyf.AdaptiveProbeConfig.max_probes) | int([x]) -> integer |
| [min_probes](#dyf.AdaptiveProbeConfig.min_probes) | int([x]) -> integer |
